en.Anycubic startet aus dem erhaltenen Orig: Anycubic boots from the preserved original slot. To return to KobraNest, open the “KobraNest starten” app in Rinkhals, set boot_confirmation to KOBRIAN and idle_confirmed to True, then choose “Start app”. No print may be running or paused.
en.Anycubic wird für den nächsten Start aus: Anycubic will be selected for the next boot and the printer will shut down cleanly. Wait at least 15 seconds, switch the printer off, wait ten seconds and switch it on again. No automatic reboot. Return to KobraNest using the Rinkhals “KobraNest starten” app.
en.Anycubic vorbereitet. Der Drucker wird h: Anycubic is prepared. The printer is shutting down. Wait at least 15 seconds, switch it off at the power switch, wait ten seconds and switch it on again.
en.LAN für den Druckerbetrieb. WLAN mit eig: LAN for printer operation. Wi-Fi uses its own DHCP address when the Wi-Fi add-on is installed.
en.Einmal LAN oder USB auswählen und dauerh: Choose LAN or USB once and keep using it. This switch changes the printer only. Prepare the Pi manually first; start Klipper on the Pi after the S1 restarts. Networking is still required for the display, Moonraker and web dashboard.
Stop Klipper on the Pi before each change. Switch only while idle.
en.USB: MCU-Pfade /dev/ttyGS0 und /dev/ttyG: USB: use MCU paths /dev/ttyGS0 and /dev/ttyGS1. Disable Pi LAN services mcu1 and mcu2 and remove automatic LAN starts from Klipper ExecStartPre. The USB gadget must be active.
en.LAN: MCU-Pfade /dev/ttyMCU1 und /dev/tty: LAN: use MCU paths /dev/ttyMCU1 and /dev/ttyMCU2. Enable Pi LAN services mcu1 and mcu2. After the S1 restarts, start those services and then Klipper.
en.Die USB-Anzeige bestätigt laufende Brück: The USB indicator confirms running bridges. Confirm both MCU connections with Klipper status ready and valid temperatures.
en.Aktive LAN- oder WLAN-Verbindung mit IPv: An active LAN or Wi-Fi connection with an IPv4 address is required.
en.Netzwerkverbindung mit Drucker-IP vorhan: Network connection with printer IP is available.
en.Keine aktive Verbindung mit der konfigur: No active connection with the configured printer IP.
